branch_activations.independent_trigger: The preceding grave relation and the supplied earth-release and deed-emergence relations provide the outward-to-inward sequence.
branch_activations.activation: The collection carrier follows an external disassembly, so the focus gathers what the earlier operation has scattered.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The focus is the inward gathering that follows the outward opening and scattering.
branch_activations.boundary: The sequence is a contextual relation and does not make the focus a grammatical continuation of any unquoted form.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: toplama ve elde kalanı ortaya koyma
branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir hesap veya iş bittikten ve öteki unsurlar gittikten sonra geriye kalan sabit sonuç da bu anlam alanına girer.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus passive carries the fixed result that follows the clearing of other material.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The supplied release and final-emergence relations place a settled result after the outward operation.
branch_activations.activation: The result facet completes the two-pass movement from opened enclosure to resolved interior.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: After the exterior is scattered, the inward contents settle into a result.
branch_activations.boundary: The result remains unspecified and is not equated with either treasure or residue.

findings.title: Göğüsteki iç çekirdeğin çıkarılması
findings.claim: The extraction word can target the heart's inner kernel within the chest, so the contents are differentiated as an inner core being brought out of its covering.
findings.mechanism: The focus carrier 100:10:1:2 activates root_000330/B002, while the contextual carrier at 100:8 supplies root_000286/B004's heart-kernel image. The focus return through the extraction word makes the kernel a target of the operation rather than a free-standing association.
findings.reader_payoff: The plural contents of the chest become internally differentiated: the reader can perceive a core being reached within the larger interior.
findings.containment: The ordinary chest-content reading remains primary and recoverable. The heart-kernel is a qualified contextual image, not a claim that the ayah names one exclusive content or a literal extraction procedure.

epistemic.reason: The reader walk anchors the focus extraction and contextual heart-kernel branch, but its source and nominated branch remain legacy-unbound.

branch_activations.facet_statement: İçteki özlü veya değerli bölüm, onu saran maddeden ayrılır ve dışarı çıkarılır.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus extraction form carries bringing an inner core out from its covering.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The contextual heart-kernel image supplies a distinct inner object within the chest.
branch_activations.activation: The extraction carrier meets the heart-kernel trigger, so the focus operation targets a differentiated core.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The chest contents can be heard as an inner heart-kernel being brought out.
branch_activations.boundary: The kernel is not asserted as the only content or as a literal anatomical operation.

branch_activations.facet_statement: İç kısmı kabuktan veya taneyi samandan çıkarma, aynı ayırıp çıkarma yapısını somutlaştırır.
branch_activations.carrier: The extraction word carries the concrete structure of an inside removed from a shell-like surround.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The contextual heart-kernel image supplies the inner-versus-covering contrast.
branch_activations.activation: The concrete separation facet makes the heart-kernel target intelligible as something reached through a covering.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The inner kernel is disclosed through an operation of separation from its surrounding chest.
branch_activations.boundary: No literal shell, grain, or physical procedure is added to the focus.

branch_activations.carrier: The supplied contextual heart-kernel carries the innermost core of the chest's inward content.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus extraction word supplies the operation that brings an inner part out.
branch_activations.activation: The heart-kernel carrier returns through the focus extraction, becoming a target of the disclosed operation.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The extracted content can be perceived as the heart's inner kernel.
branch_activations.boundary: This is a contextual resonance and does not define every chest content as a heart-kernel.

findings.title: Çıkarımın yeni bilgi değil, hesabın açığa çıkması oluşu
findings.claim: The tested-knowledge context makes the focus collection resolve and manifest an inward account rather than acquire new information.
findings.mechanism: The context carrier at 100:11 activates root_000387/B001's tested-inward-knowledge image, and the focus carrier 100:10:1:2 supplies the collection and disclosure operation. Their contact changes the passive extraction into the manifestation of an account already held in the inward domain.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can distinguish disclosure from acquisition: what the focus brings out is an account made manifest, not knowledge newly produced by the act of extraction.
findings.containment: The focus still says that what is in the chests is extracted or brought out. The finding does not make a theological claim beyond the supplied reader-walk qualification and does not assign an acting agent.

epistemic.reason: The retrospective reader-walk support explicitly states the before-and-after correction, while its tested-knowledge branch is a nominated contextual branch.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: knowledge by report and tested inner knowledge
branch_activations.carrier: The supplied tested-knowledge image carries an inward account established by knowledge and report.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus extraction word gathers and manifests what is in the chest.
branch_activations.activation: Tested inward knowledge meets the focus collection operation, so the act resolves an account instead of creating new knowledge.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The focus discloses an already established inward account.
branch_activations.boundary: The supplied record does not authorize a universal claim about divine knowledge or identify an agent for the passive form.
